title: Why I Came
transcript:
District Jail. The notice board outside the canteen, a printed sheet behind cracked plastic.
VOLUNTEERS SOUGHT. TRAUMA-MEMORY RESEARCH. REMISSION OF SENTENCE MAY APPLY.
Principal Investigator: Dr. Meera Varma.

He reads the name eleven times.

On the bus he tells himself three different reasons.
To be punished. To say it, finally, to the one person who is owed it.
To have it taken out of him like a stone.

He doesn't know which one is true.

PARTH:
"Where do I sign?"
